content.short: Elementerra is a Solana city where players combine elements to invent for rewards.
content.description: Elementerra invites players to push the boundaries of creativity by using Elementum and blending Air, Earth, Fire, and Water to bring inventions to life, turning imagination into tangible in-game results. The journey offers a wealth of NFTs to earn, plus locked SOL prizes and inventor rewards to win, providing ongoing opportunities as ideas evolve into items and recognition. Ultimately, players can aim to make history by having their name immortalized on the Inventors Wall within the game's virtual hall of fame.
